name: Wireframe (redacted)
description: The Wireframe theme with copy redacted — text is replaced by solid grey bars so reviewers focus purely on layout, hierarchy, and density rather than reading the words. Same black/grey/white, no-shadow, zero-radius, monospace foundation as Wireframe; the redaction is layered on by apps/a1-web wireframe-redacted.css. Apply class="a1-theme-wireframe-redacted" to <html>.
